qs.en: His team displayed a record performance at the last national championships.

qs.en: The engineers tested the new processor's performance under extreme conditions.

qs.en: The performance of this electric car in terms of range is impressive.

qs.en: The annual report evaluates the company's financial performance over twelve months.

qs.en: The contemporary artist performed a live performance in the gallery, mixing body and paint.

qs.en: This artistic performance lasted three hours and deeply unsettled the spectators.

qs.en: Management put in place indicators to measure the individual performance of each employee.

qs.en: To improve the website's performance, the technical team optimized the code.

qs.en: Despite an injury, she turned in an admirable performance during the competition.
